words.prose: {{ar:مَلِكِ}} ({{tr:maliki}}) is not a new sentence after 114:1; its genitive case and omitted governing frame keep the refuge formula running across the ayah boundary. As a construct head before {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}), it makes sovereignty a grammatical relation over the human domain, not a loose royal label. Because the construct takes definiteness from {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}), the title does not sound like some indefinite king but identifies the known sovereign of the whole human domain. The title's middle position shifts the opening chain from {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}) in 114:1 toward {{ar:إِلَٰهِ}} ({{tr:ilāhi}}) in 114:3, so the same people are re-read first under nurture, then under rule, then under deity. That governed domain will later be contrasted with whispering inside human breasts in 114:5. Lexically, the selected sense is kingly command and rule, while the accepted {{ar:مَالِكِ}} ({{tr:māliki}}) variant and the ownership field keep possession close to the surface without changing the local syntax. Even the root's cohesion or kneading image survives only as narrowed pressure: the King is not merely distant status, but authority that holds and shapes the governed human field. The clipped consonants and paired genitive vowels help the two-word phrase sound bound as one epithet.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}) is the stable human-domain word while the opening titles rotate around it. In 114:2 it is genitive as the complement of {{ar:مَلِكِ}} ({{tr:maliki}}), so the people are presented as the governed field of sovereignty rather than as actors in the phrase. Its full repeated noun form, with its own definite article, avoids pronoun compression and renews the universal scope after each title in 114:1-3. The collective form gathers many individuals into one domain under the King, while the wider {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) family lets that domain feel relational, familiar, and perceiving; contested forgetfulness and wavering derivations add vulnerability-pressure without replacing the local meaning of humankind. The same word later turns from governed domain into the place where whispering targets human interiors in {{ar:صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:ṣudūri al-nās}}) in 114:5. Because the domain is delayed until after the title, the ayah lands on mankind rather than on kingship by itself; the supplied pair data also makes the people-and-rule relation a marked association, not an accidental adjacency. Recitationally, the assimilated article, doubled n sound, and long closing sound make the human refrain audible at the end of the ayah.

topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a definite concrete noun denoting humankind, and the contextual profile's dominant referent is generic humans.

topics.headline: relational and perceiving human pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the governed domain as perceiving and relational humanity, while the local noun still simply names the human collective.
topics.reason: The local root alignment supports {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}), while missing V4 rows for this root do not block coherent family pressure from the CRITICAL evidence.

topics.headline: forgetfulness and wavering as vulnerability pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the protected human domain with vulnerability to forgetting or wavering, without replacing the local root alignment.
topics.reason: QAC aligns the local root as {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}), so alternate derivations survive only as contested lexical pressure relevant to the surah's later whispering threat.

topics.headline: from ruled domain to whisper target in 114:5
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same human noun from the King's governed domain in 114:2 to the interior target-space of whispering in 114:5.
topics.reason: The source rows give the concrete same-surah relation: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}) is governed in 114:2 and appears in {{ar:صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:ṣudūri al-nās}}) in 114:5.

topics.headline: human domain as closing anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah land on the human collective, so the title's endpoint is mankind rather than kingship by itself.
topics.reason: The word closes 114:2 and reprises the closing noun from 114:1, while the construct order delays the governed domain until the end.

topics.headline: assimilated sound makes the refrain audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear definiteness, construct attachment, and the surah's closing pattern in the word's assimilated and lengthened sound.
topics.reason: The hamzat-wasl connection, sun-letter assimilation, doubled n sound, and long closing sound reinforce the repeated human-domain ending without changing the grammar.

topics.headline: human noun paired with sovereignty root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the phrase's people-and-rule pairing as part of a documented local association rather than an accidental adjacency.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL pair claim coheres with the local idafa: {{ar:مَلِكِ}} ({{tr:maliki}}) governs {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nās}}), and the contextual evidence does not contradict that pairing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct phrase joins مَلِكِ at word 1 to ٱلنَّاسِ at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The kingship branch supplies dominion and public governance, while the people branch supplies a visible human collective. The relation is therefore active jurisdiction over a human polity, not merely an honorific attached to an unspecified king.

activation_trace.role: Kingship, dominion, and governance supply the governing relation expressed by مَلِكِ.
Visible human presence supplies the governed collective denoted by ٱلنَّاسِ.

changed_reading.after: The one whose sovereignty actively orders the visible human collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَلِكِ can activate ownership and disposal, and ٱلنَّاسِ can activate the individual self as well as the collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ownership is read functionally as the right to dispose, authorize, and delegate. Joined to the self-bearing branch of people, the phrase reaches human agency and not only public territory.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal supply a jurisdiction capable of authorizing action.
The idiom of one's own self carries the governed object inward from population to person.

changed_reading.before: A monarch standing over a population.
changed_reading.after: The holder of legitimate disposal over each human self's field of action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of مَلِكِ carries both cohesion and the mainstay on which a matter depends; ٱلنَّاسِ names the human body social.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rule can be imagined as load-bearing coherence: the king is not only above the people but is the support by which their collective and personal order holds together.

activation_trace.role: Strength and cohesion make sovereignty the force that prevents disintegration.
The mainstay on which a matter depends makes the king a structural support.
Human presence supplies the social and personal material being held together.

changed_reading.after: Kingship as the cohesive mainstay by which human order remains standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَلِكِ carries images of a road's main course and a leading forepart, while ٱلنَّاسِ carries the near, human-facing side.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can spatialize sovereignty as orientation: a center-course leads, and the human-facing side turns toward it. This is not a replacement gloss for king but a live functional image of leadership.

activation_trace.role: The center or main course supplies an orienting axis for the governing term.
The leading forepart supplies movement in advance that the rest can follow.
The near, person-facing side makes people the side oriented toward that lead.

changed_reading.after: The orienting center and leading course toward which the human-facing side is ordered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding imperative makes the sequence a voiced act, refuge makes protection an entered and clung-to relation, and lordship adds repair and nurture. مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ consequently becomes a protective jurisdiction occupied by the seeker, not a detached report about rank.

activation_trace.role: Dominion supplies the jurisdiction into which the refuge-act is read.
Cohesion gives that jurisdiction a protective, holding function.
Utterance makes the title participate in an enacted spoken appeal.
Seeking shelter supplies the protective motion toward the sovereign.
Clinging and remaining within a shelter turns dominion into an inhabitable protection.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the protective rule restorative rather than merely coercive.

structural_cues: 114:2 continues the genitive title sequence opened by the refuge statement in 114:1.
The title is received after an imperative to speak, so its discourse function is performative as well as descriptive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voiced saying, sheltering attachment, nurture, and dominion; I infer that the title names the capacity by which refuge works. A live alternative is that the titles only identify the addressee and do not distribute separate protective functions.

changed_reading.before: The king of people as an externally described sovereign.
changed_reading.after: The sovereign whose cohesive, nurturing jurisdiction is entered and clung to through the spoken refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Between nurturing lordship and worshipped divinity, kingship becomes the middle register that converts care into ordered allegiance. The repeated people-construction keeps one human object constant while the governing relation changes register.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion supply the care-register immediately before kingship.
Kingship and governance supply the ordering middle register.
Worship and the worshipped supply the allegiance-register after kingship.
Repeated visible humanity keeps the same relational object across all three titles.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence is رَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ, مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ, إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered titles and a repeated human complement; I infer a care-to-governance-to-worship progression in which kingship is a hinge. The live alternative is cumulative apposition with no directional progression.

changed_reading.before: One divine title among adjacent synonyms.
changed_reading.after: The hinge where nurturing care becomes public order and prepares freely directed worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes commanded, externalized speech to unshown inner speech and whispering at the source of action. مَلِكِ then governs a speech boundary: which prompt remains hidden, which becomes voiced, and which voice receives obedience.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overt utterance, unmanifest inner speech, hidden self-talk, and an action-source; I infer competition for practical obedience and assign kingship jurisdiction over that boundary. reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Kingship as public governance over the wavering many.** Evidence: م ل ك B003, kingship and dominion; ر ب ب B001 from 114:1, lordship/ownership/authority; ء ل ه B001 from 114:3, worship and the worshipped one; ن و س B001, swaying oscillation. Structural cue: this middle title is framed by رب before it and إله after it, all attached to الناس. Assigned role: ملك supplies the public-political register between caretaking lordship and devotional deity. Abductive move: the sequence moves from possession/care to governance to worship so that the same unstable human field is secured at multiple levels. Reading change: “King of people” reads less as isolated royal epithet and more as the governing layer in a protective triad.

2. **Sovereignty as cohesion of the inner polity.** Evidence: م ل ك B001, strength and cohesion; م ل ك B005, mainstay of a matter, including the heart as body’s mainstay; ص د ر B004 from 114:5, source from which forms issue; و س و س B001 from 114:5, hidden inward whisper. Structural cue: the later battlefield is inside “صدور الناس,” while this ayah names ملك before that interior is revealed. Assigned role: ملك is the power that makes a self or community hold together against internal whisper-fracture. Abductive move: if the attack is inside the chest, kingship must include control of the principle that keeps the inner structure coherent. Reading change: “King” reads as stabilizing sovereignty over the interior source of action, not merely external rule.

3. **King as central course and lead point.** Evidence: م ل ك B006, center or main course of road/valley; م ل ك B008, leading forepart in animals; ن و س B002, driving camels; خ ن س B005 from 114:4, a horse veering during its run. Structural cue: the surah moves from command/refuge to a sequence of titles, then to a veering/withdrawing whisperer. Assigned role: ملك marks the correct center-line and leading point for a moving body. Abductive move: a community that can sway or be driven requires a sovereign center-course to resist veering. Reading change: the ayah reads as alignment of direction, not only statement of rank.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later chest-language changed this ayah most. Before 114:5, مَلِك could stay at the level of public sovereignty, supported by م ل ك B003. After “في صدور الناس,” م ل ك B001/B005 became active: kingship also means the cohesion/mainstay that keeps the inner person from being fractured by whisper. 114:4’s خناس further made م ل ك B006/B008 visible as central-course and lead-point: sovereignty counters veering, withdrawal, and oscillation. The surprise is that monarchy here governs not only people as a public body but the interior route by which people become movable.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Public sovereignty reaches the covert interior.** م ل ك `B003` gives `مَلِكِ` kingship, dominion, and governance of a population. The title is the middle member of `رَبِّ / مَلِكِ / إِلَٰهِ`, each bound to repeated `ٱلنَّاسِ`, but 114:4-5 reveals that the actual disturbance is hidden and takes place `فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ`. The packet supplies public governance and private location; I infer sovereignty -> jurisdiction over the otherwise unseen interior channel. The title thus becomes operational protection rather than a ceremonial rank.

2. **Kingship supplies cohesion to swaying people.** The dormant م ل ك `B001` image is strength and cohesion, explicitly including what holds a wall or a self together; the fixed `ٱلنَّاسِ` activates ن و س `B001`, oscillating or wavering movement. Later, repeated whispering and خ ن س `B001/B005` supply withdrawal and veering. I infer the approach-withdraw influence -> fragmentation or wavering, while `مَلِكِ` -> the cohesion that keeps the human subject from being pulled with it. The phrase can therefore be read materially as the stabilizing hold over an unstable collective and self.

3. **The sovereign title marks an inner mainstay.** م ل ك `B005` names the support on which a matter depends and specifically images the heart as the body's mainstay. Its later proximity to `صُدُورِ` (ص د ر `B001`) makes that otherwise dormant branch visible: the attack is aimed at the bodily/inner front whose governing support is already named. The packet gives mainstay and breast; I infer possession of the mainstay -> resistance at the point from which conduct is organized. `مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ` consequently acquires an inward axis alongside its social-political one.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 114:5 activated م ل ك `B005` retrospectively: its “heart as mainstay” image became functional once the breast was named as the target. Then 114:6 widened sovereignty from control of recipients to control of human transmitters, so the disturbance proved internal to the governed social field rather than a rival realm.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin parçalarının sıkıca bağlanarak güçlü, dayanıklı ve dağılmaya dirençli hâle gelmesi veya getirilmesidir. Kişide bu iç tutarlılık, düşmekten ya da düşünmeden konuşmaktan kendini alıkoyma biçiminde görünür.

facets.statement: Bir şey, parçaları çözülmeden bir arada duracak güç ve iç tutarlılık taşır.
Hamur sıkı ve bütünlüklü bir kıvama gelinceye kadar kuvvetle yoğrulur.
Bir bitki sürgünü kurutularak sert ve dayanıklı hâle getirilir.
Bir yapı veya kişi, çökmesini ya da denetimsiz davranmasını önleyen iç tutarlılığı korur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gücün yalnız dış kuvvet değil, nesneyi veya kişiyi çözülmeden ayakta tutan sıkılık ve tutarlılık olmasıdır; verilen örnekler bu niteliğin maddi ve davranışsal görünümlerini gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel sahiplik çekirdeği ile el altında bulundurma, kölelik, iyi muamele ve boşanma yetkisini devretme gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmadan tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin bir kişinin elinde veya hukuki alanında bulunması ve o kişinin onun üzerinde tasarruf yetkisi taşımasıdır. Bu yetki devredilebilir; tarihsel kullanımlarda köleleştirilmiş kişileri ve onlara ilişkin davranışı, belirli bir kalıpta ise boşanma kararının eşe bırakılmasını da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, mal veya hak üzerinde sahiplikten doğan elinde bulundurma ve tasarruf yetkisine sahiptir.
Sahiplik bir başkasına geçirilebilir veya belirli bir konuda karar yetkisi o kişiye bırakılabilir.
Tarihsel kullanımda sahip olunan kişi, köleleştirilmiş insanı ve ona ilişkin sahiplik durumunu belirtir.
Belirli bir kalıp, sahibin köleleştirilmiş kişilere iyi davranmasını ifade eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sahipliği bir şeyin elde veya hukuki denetimde bulunması ve üzerinde hükme bağlı tasarruf kurulması olarak birleştirir; devir, kölelik ve özel karar yetkisi bu ilişkinin tarihsel ya da kalıplaşmış uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli sözlerde kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta gösterilen soru ve kişi bağlantısı kuruluşlarını topluca açıklarken kullanılabilir; genel bir kişi ya da akraba adı değildir.
